info.description: Node.js/Express/CommonJS/Mongoose. USER and STAFF are resolved through existing Auth /api/auth/me on every business request. UTC timestamps; VND integers. Internal caller identity comes only from a directional credential.

post.summary: STAFF advances a booking demo clock
post.description: Requires PAWSTAY_DEMO_ENABLED=true outside production. TO_APPOINTMENT requires CONFIRMED and an accepted payment; TO_HANDOVER requires a demo CHECKED_IN booking. Only fixed milestones are accepted; booking status is unchanged. Idempotency-Key is required. Replays and concurrent commands retain existing anchors; replay returns the current STAFF snapshot. Existing pet/resource transaction guards serialize clocks and Care transitions. DEMO_DISABLED or an ineligible booking returns 409.

post.summary: Process an already verified Payment event
post.description: Only PAYMENT_TO_BOOKING_TOKEN credential is allowed. Valid business rejection is 200 with accepted=false and a terminal outcome; retry only transient transport/503 errors using the same event_id. Identical event replay is stable; conflicting payload is 409. No VNPAY signature/IPN processing here.

get.summary: Care reads the authoritative Booking service time
get.description: Only CARE_TO_BOOKING_TOKEN is allowed. Care uses business_now to timestamp demo activities. Returns DEMO_DISABLED (409) for an existing demo when disabled; persisted anchors and history remain intact. This endpoint never changes the clock. Real time still controls payment holds, lease and retry.

post.description: Only CARE_TO_BOOKING_TOKEN credential is allowed. Care must verify current STAFF before asserting actor_id. Successful and state-conflict results are persisted by request_id; a changed payload is 409. Check-in respects actual readiness, preparation/cleaning intervals and configured time window; checkout preserves/extends the resource buffer and rejects future conflicts atomically. Only demo service windows and checked_in_at/completed_at use the booking business clock; optional *_recorded_at and History.at retain real audit time. Hold expiry always uses real time. Existing demo bookings reject new actions with DEMO_DISABLED when configuration is disabled.

BookingInput.description: CARE requires start_at; BOARDING requires check_in_date and check_out_date. DAY-priced rooms additionally require check_in_time and check_out_time (GMT+7). The two modes are mutually exclusive. Any price, duration, end_at, owner or status supplied by the client is rejected.

expected_pet_version.description: Required for quotes that return pet_version. Use the value from the reviewed quote.

price_rule_id.description: Selected price group for services with grouped prices.

pet_version.description: Present for grouped prices. Send as expected_pet_version when confirming the quote.

DemoClock.description: STAFF time sample, present when demo is enabled or this booking is already marked demo. Disabled demo bookings retain their business timeline and block new simulated actions.

DemoClockContext.description: Persisted booking demo anchors. Business time equals business_anchor_at plus elapsed real time. Commands advance once per stage and never replace anchors on replay.

Error.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, conflict, dependency or internal error. No stack or connection details.
